scope: Low-speed linear attached-flow wing-only VLM; not CFD, full-aircraft flight performance, stall, intake or transonic validation.
source: Existing Pocket Flight lab solver.ts and experiments.ts, unchanged.

checks.name: All 17 sweep cases finite and small residual
Lift increases through the attached-flow sweep
Symmetric baseline near zero lift at zero angle
Positive lift and induced drag at four degrees

assumptions: Exposed stations measured from exact saved wings.step cross-sections in millimetres; converted to metres.
A theoretical centreline continuation supplies the VLM area basis; the fuselage hides this portion. The turned-down inboard attachment skirt is omitted from aerodynamic stations.
Declared aircraft aerodynamic reference area56.49m² and reference AR3.01/taper0.25 are distinct from this fuller physical outline and the area integrated from these measured stations.

Physical outline retains13.04925m span, LE45deg and dihedral−1deg; exposed root/tip chords and aft position were corrected against the NASA-hosted top view. Reference drawing is not production manufacturing data.
Analytic 6→3% sections and camber beginning outboard of the 20% semispan station are visual approximations, not measured production F-15C airfoil coordinates.
Zero lift angle and incidence are set to 0° for this baseline sensitivity run; the true cambered-section zero-lift data is unverified.
Linear attached-flow wing-only VLM at low speed: no fuselage, inlet flow, transonic shocks, separation, stall or full-aircraft validation.
